decisions.reason: The explicitly announced new business unit for offshore markets represents a visible and likely substantial commitment that management will be reluctant to reverse while the firm is expanding and pursuing broader, more sustainable maritime services.

Because crew and corporate travel management is very close to the firm's established service base, management can justify continuing it as part of the wider offer even if standalone results are mixed.

The online vessel information portal fits the push toward broader customer support, but with only limited visible public commitment it is more vulnerable than the service-based launches if uptake remains weak.
The mobile vessel performance app looks like the most peripheral and easiest-to-abandon digital add-on, with relatively little public commitment compared with the resources needed to maintain it.
